text: Let's say there's a girl you like, maybe your classmate, your co-worker, or even your barista, but you are not sure if she likes you back. Here are five signs that can tell you she is into you. Number one, and that's a big one, she touches you. You tease her, make a joke, and she touches your shoulder or your arm. Maybe even sits close and bumps into you. That's not random, that's a sign. Number two, she fixes how she looks when you show up. Hair, posture, makeup, if she adjusts something the moment you walk in, she's trying to look good for someone, and maybe that someone is you. Number three, her mood changes. She was kind of neutral, and then you show up, and boom, she's smiling, energized. That's another one. Number four, she actually listens, like really listens. Eye contact, follow-up questions, totally engaged. You can feel when someone is present. And number five, she laughs at your jokes, even when your jokes are not that funny. Yeah man, then that means she likes you. So one of these signs is already good. Two or more, that's your green light. Ask her out, or if you're on a date, go for that kiss.
